import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Read and aggregate revenue by month
df = pd.read_csv('/mnt/uploads/sales.csv')
monthly = df.groupby('month', as_index=False)['revenue'].sum().sort_values('month')
monthly['pct_change'] = monthly['revenue'].pct_change() * 100
plot_data = monthly.dropna(subset=['pct_change'])

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(8, 5))
ax.bar(plot_data['month'], plot_data['pct_change'], color=['#4C78A8' if v >= 0 else '#E45756' for v in plot_data['pct_change']])
ax.axhline(0, color='black', linewidth=0.8)
ax.set_xlabel('Month')
ax.set_ylabel('Month-over-month change in total revenue (%)')
ax.set_title('Month-over-month Percent Change in Total Revenue')
ax.set_ylim(0, max(plot_data['pct_change']) * 1.15)
ax.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.25)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
